main_idea: AfterQuery warmup improves Nemotron 3 Ultra’s GDPval score by 11.4 points.
ideas: Warmup raises GDPval score from 35.3 to 46.7.
Warmup score comes within 2.8 points of the teacher.
summary: The slogan, category tags, long subtitle, gain callout, and footer extras clutter a complete GDPval comparison.
